I’ve attached the standard onboarding packet for convenience (fillable PDF). Please return the completed PDF and the W-9; once we have both, I’ll kick off the creation in our vendor master and send you the vendor ID and PO instructions.

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Solstice.pdf (fillable PDF)

Next steps:
- You: return filled form + W-9 + bank remit instructions

Thanks,
